title: Codex Security: now in research preview
summary: Codex Security is an AI application security agent that analyzes project context to detect, validate, and patch complex vulnerabilities with higher confidence and less noise.
body: Codex Security is an AI application security agent that analyzes project context to detect, validate, and patch complex vulnerabilities with higher confidence and less noise.
summaryZh: OpenAI推出Codex Security研究预览版，这是一个专注于代码安全的AI代理。它能够分析项目上下文，自动检测、验证并修复复杂的安全漏洞，旨在提升开发效率并降低误报率。

aiReview.reasonZh: Codex Security作为AI安全代理，展示了模型在代码漏洞修复领域的自动化能力。
